messages.subject: Creating a linear function
parts:
Dear Shiny forum group,  

Is it possible to create a Shiny app that would allow users to submit input values for a linear function, and produce a line plot that would show that linear function?  Specifically, I want the users to be able to choose their own input value, which would be multiplied by a constant to determine the slope.  I would also like to allow the users to choose their own input value for the intercept.  

I would deeply appreciate any tips or recommendations.  Thanks!  

Best, 
Jisoo

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Creating a linear function
parts:
This would just be like any other simple Shiny app, use numericInput or sliderInput for the input values and for the plot do something like:

renderPlot({
  plot.window(xlim=c(0,1), ylim=c(0,1))  # Set to whatever you want the limits to be
  abline(a = input$intercept, b = input$slope)
  axis(1)
  axis(2)
})
